subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep the current generic direct-route 404 and surface specific reasons only through authenticated metadata/UI, or should `/avatar/{agentId}` itself expose more specific failure statuses?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on authenticated local workspace file serving, so richer endpoint errors improve UX but may change information-disclosure boundaries.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic while using existing metadata reasons and Control UI surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return statuses such as 413 or 400 from the direct avatar route after explicit security review and redaction tests.

options.title: Fold Into Avatar Contract
options.body: Defer local diagnostics to the broader remote/local avatar contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic while using existing metadata reasons and Control UI surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across avatar support, avatar safety hardening, and Gateway/Control UI security surfaces.
